stem.text: A skydiver leaves a stationary balloon and falls vertically through a long distance.
Which graph best represents the variation of the acceleration $a$ of the skydiver with the distance $s$ travelled as she falls through the air?

A.alt: Graph with a vertical axis labelled a and a horizontal axis labelled s, showing a curve that starts high on the vertical axis and falls towards the horizontal axis.

B.alt: Graph with a vertical axis labelled a and a horizontal axis labelled s, showing a curve that starts at the origin, rises, and levels off.

C.alt: Graph with a vertical axis labelled a and a horizontal axis labelled s, showing a horizontal straight line above the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph with a vertical axis labelled a and a horizontal axis labelled s, showing a straight line from the origin rising to the right.
